newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Bank preparing internal TV network.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank preparing internal TV network.

text.p: Deutsche Bank said on Wednesday it was in talks with German phone giant Deutsche Telekom AG and Bavarian media mogul Leo Kirch about setting up its planned internal corporate television network.
A bank spokesman said the talks were preliminary and that the company had not yet made any decisions about who would supply the network or decoder technology for the internal digital TV network.
"Nothing is clear yet, it is all under consideration," the spokesman said.
He said the bank still planned to start the network next year and that it would be used to train employees and inform them about new products.
The service would probably be carried by satellite and start sometime next year, servicing Deutsche's 1,500 German branches. It would later be expanded internationally.
